    w=params[0]
    c=np.cos(w*t); s=np.sin(w*t); e=np.exp(-v)
    return (params[1]+params[2]*c+params[3]*s+params[4]*v*c+params[5]*e+params[6]*e*c

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    c=np.cos(w*t); s=np.sin(w*t); e=np.exp(-v); lv=np.log(v)
    return (params[1]+params[2]*c+params[3]*s+params[4]*v+params[5]*v*c+params[6]*e+params[7]*e*c
            +params[8]*e*s+params[9]*lv)
